title: StoneCharts Chart Spec
description: Language-agnostic recipe for one chart. Unknown keys are ignored (forward-compatible); renderers grow field support phase by phase. Keep language spec models (libs/*/spec) in lockstep with this file.

type.description: Chart type id for the active 0.0.0.1 release scope; maps to the released chart design and renderer pair.

id.description: Chart instance id, used to namespace <defs> ids (gradients/patterns) so multiple charts on one page don't collide. Set a unique value per chart when embedding several.

theme.description: Color theme. A built-in name ('light' = default, byte-identical to the classic look; 'dark'), or a full theme object. Resolved server-side into concrete SVG attributes (never CSS variables).

responsive.description: When true the SVG scales to its container (viewBox + preserveAspectRatio + width:100%) instead of a fixed pixel size. Default false keeps fixed width/height.

a11y.description: Accessibility (on by default): SVG gets role="img" + a summary aria-label + <desc>; the HTML output adds a visually-hidden data table. Set false to restore the pre-a11y byte output.

stacking.description: Stack series values per category. 'normal' = absolute stacked with signed positive/negative accumulators, 'percent' = 100% stacked using non-negative values only. Absent = no stacking.

grouping.description: When true (default) multi-series bars/columns sit side-by-side; when false they overlay.

theme.description: Concrete color set. Canonical values live in spec/themes/*.json; a custom object may override any field. Omitted fields fall back to the light theme.

gradient.description: Linear gradient. Direction is x1,y1 -> x2,y2 in 0..1 objectBoundingBox coords (default 0,0 -> 0,1 = vertical top-to-bottom). No trig, so both renderers format it identically.

pattern.description: Hatch (diagonal-line) fill for the area under the line. Print- and colorblind-friendly. Renders as an SVG <pattern> tile.

background.description: Optional solid tile background behind the hatch lines.

categories.description: Category labels. On xAxis, index i of each series maps to categories[i].

gridLine.description: Horizontal gridline styling. Defaults reproduce the built-in look (solid #e8e8ee).

color.description: Series color: a hex string, or a linear-gradient object (fades between stops). Gradient applies to the stroke and area fill; markers/legend use the first stop's color.

fillOpacity.description: Fill the area under the line down to the zero baseline at this opacity. 0 = no fill (default). Any value > 0 turns a line chart into an area chart.

step.description: Draw as a stepped line instead of straight segments.

curve.description: Line interpolation. 'monotone' = smooth Fritsch-Carlson spline (no overshoot). Default = straight segments.

marker.description: Data-point markers. Defaults reproduce the built-in circle (r 3.5).
